questionnaire.one_line_about_field: Photovoltaic arrays lose output when dust accumulates.
questionnaire.two_lines_about_domain: Cleaning is manual and costly. Automated cleaning is rare.
questionnaire.three_lines_about_area: Existing washers need water and leave streaks.
questionnaire.four_lines_about_problem: Soiling can cut output by 15%. Manual cleaning is unsafe on rooftops.
questionnaire.four_lines_about_solution: A wiper travels on a rail and sweeps the panel surface.
questionnaire.problem_statement: Dust and pollen reduce photovoltaic output and require unsafe manual cleaning.
questionnaire.proposed_solution: An automated wiper sweeps the panel on a rail.
questionnaire.technical_description: The wiper is driven by a small motor along a rail fixed to the panel frame.
questionnaire.prior_art: US 9,000,000: Manual panel washer. Not automated.
questionnaire.exemplary_scenario: A rooftop array cleans itself each morning.
questionnaire.detailed_exemplary_scenario: A motor drives the wiper along the rail; a controller starts it at dawn.
questionnaire.best_working_method: Mount the rail on the long edge and drive the wiper with a 12V motor.
